papers_read.title_as_printed: Deep learning-based classification of healthy aging controls, mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease using fusion of MRI-PET imaging (Rallabandi & Seetharaman, 2023, doi 10.1016/j.bspc.2022.104312, file S1746809422007662)
A mobile application using automatic speech analysis for classifying Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment (Yamada et al., Computer Speech & Language 81 (2023) 101514)

what_each_reports.P-117: The record's P-117 (summaries.md header S1746809423005462: resting-state EEG, VMD entropy features, NSGA-II channel selection, best ~99.8% accuracy, sample not reported) could not be checked: the pack PDF is a different paper (OASIS MRI-PET fusion, 95.5% HC vs MCI accuracy, AUC 0.988, internal 60/20/20 split). 99.81% does not appear in the supplied PDF.
what_each_reports.P-60: Tablet-app speech features (92 acoustic/prosodic/linguistic), LASSO + SVM-RBF, nested leave-one-out CV, 114 Japanese participants (43 CN, 46 MCI, 25 AD) from University of Tsukuba. MCI vs CN accuracy 87.6% (sens 88.1%, spec 87.2%); three-class accuracy 78.6%; AD vs CN 91.2%.

quantity_a: Record's P-117: resting-state EEG classifier accuracy, MCI vs healthy, own unnamed EEG cohort, internal validation (summary block only).
quantity_b: P-60: speech-feature SVM accuracy, MCI vs CN, 89 Japanese participants in the binary task, nested leave-one-out CV.
incompatible_if_same: Not determinable and not needed; different modality, cohort and predictor representation. Each paper reports its own method's score; neither claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match for the binary MCI vs CN figure the record uses (the registry codes P-60 as T3 because its headline is the three-class 78.6%)
gates.dataset_family: mismatch: P-60's Tsukuba speech cohort vs P-117's EEG cohort (or OASIS under the pack PDF); record's dataset_equal='Yes' unsupported
gates.validation_tier: match (both internal CV / split, V2; the registry's V3 for P-60 is not supported by an external cohort in the PDF)
gates.modality_family: mismatch: EEG (or MRI-PET) vs speech; no waiver on record

endpoint_and_metric: compatible metric type (accuracy, MCI vs control) but on different populations and input modalities
performance_validity: Likely applies to P-117 (claimed 99.81% internal accuracy, sample not reported) but unconfirmable without the correct PDF; the verdict does not rest on it.
grounds: The supplied P-117 PDF is the wrong paper (OASIS MRI-PET fusion), so the record's 99.81% EEG result cannot be read from source.
Under either identity of P-117 the modality-family gate (EEG or MRI-PET vs speech) and the dataset-family gate (Tsukuba speech cohort vs a different cohort) fail with no waiver on record.
P-60's 87.6% is correctly quoted but is a speech-based MCI vs CN accuracy in 89 Japanese participants, a different quantity from an EEG classifier's accuracy in another cohort.

evidence_quotes.quote: we develop the Inception-ResNet wrapper model in differentiating the healthy controls (HC), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and Alzheimer's disease (AD) using conjoint magnetic reso nance imaging (MRI) and positron emission tomography (PET) scans.
Reported best performance near **99.8%** using optimized subset + ensemble setup.

a machine-learning speech classifier using these features achieved 78.6% accuracy for classifying AD, MCI, and CN through nested cross-validation (AD versus CN: 91.2% accuracy; MCI versus CN: 87.6% accuracy).
Finally, a total of 114 older individuals met the inclusion criteria: 43 CN participants, 46 MCI patients, and 25 AD patients.
Second, this study used a small dataset with different sizes of diagnostic groups, which might affect the generalizability of our findings.

record_defects: P-117's paper_pdf_map entry points to the wrong PDF (S1746809422007662 MRI-PET) instead of summaries.md's S1746809423005462 (EEG); mapping marked formula-unverified.
dataset_equal='Yes' and validation_comparable='Yes' have no basis: the cohorts are unrelated.
task_equal='Yes' conflicts with the registry's T3 coding of P-60; the record silently uses the binary sub-result.
Registry row P-60: Dataset 'not reported' although the PDF names the University of Tsukuba Hospital cohort; Validation_Type V3 not supported (nested LOO CV only).
Registry row P-117: Best_Metric and Dataset 'not reported' while the claim states 99.81%.
resolution_note's bridging list is boilerplate unrelated to either paper.
what_would_change_the_verdict: The correct P-117 PDF would confirm the EEG cohort and the performance-validity status; it could not make the pair commensurable, since P-60 is speech-based on a separate cohort.
